author: Fouled
body:
Recently, in the map development team. Skyadia has decided to retire as a head map developer (maps sector), due to some reasoning, which I won't announce. In result of this, timaeusTestified will be the new head map developer in the maps sector. Thank you for all your hard work Sky, we really appreciate it! :D
And congratulations to timaeusTestified! x)
